title: VANDIRA Constituency 360 Intelligence
purpose: Evidence-grounded Assembly constituency profiles connecting 2022 verified results, 2012/2017 historical context, 2024 Lok Sabha Assembly-segment context, candidate context, booth/Form20 signals and explicit current-intelligence gaps.
rules: 2024 Lok Sabha Assembly-segment data is never represented as a 2024 Assembly election result.
Historical comparisons are descriptive and do not establish a 2027 forecast.
Winner/runner-up candidate scope is not a complete all-candidate ECI universe.
Booth/Form20 signals are descriptive 2022 context, not 2027 forecasts.
Missing issue and current-intelligence facts remain explicit gaps; no sensitive voter attributes are inferred.
political_safety: Evidence-based public political intelligence only; no sensitive-person targeting or inferred demographic/voter persuasion attributes.
